design.legacy_phase: Keep eager/default serving on the existing unspecified policy and its v1 JSON persistence.
design.graph_phase: Tune explicit graph identity before capture; scope untimed forward warmups and capture forwards to the same identity. Full captured replay needs no Python policy scope.
design.warmup_completion: Track eventual serving phase; EagerRunner is constructed first and the existing shared _kernel_warmed_up flag cannot represent two objectives.
design.mixed_execution: Prefill can replay a graph body and execute a live eager logits tail; an outer graph policy for the complete runner is too broad.
design.persistence_contract: Exact policy identity and provenance must survive real export/load, while a graph file bank cannot shadow or contaminate eager/default entries and unrelated records.
design.upstream_api_gap: Current public v1 save/load cannot safely export and select simultaneous explicit-policy and legacy winners for one file key. A supported policy-aware export/import/lookup API is needed, or a separately scoped persistence migration; neither is implemented here.
design.manual_bridge: Detached actual AutoTuner serializes a copied policy partition with remapped provenance; full policy/source/content manifest binds it. Isolated real file bank is temporarily activated only under matching graph context. Private APIs, single-thread, preexisting policy memory rejected; not production code.
design.next_checkpoint: Choose and review the supported persistence API boundary before implementing production phase routing. A subsequent current-objective versus graph-objective GPU qualification must change only that objective and carry the proven lifecycle; do not change profiling inputs simultaneously.
